title: useRevalidator
summary: Get the active router revalidation function.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: The hook takes no arguments. The returned function optionally accepts a reason and mutation context.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: An async function resolving after revalidation.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.
sections.code:
const revalidate = useRevalidator();

<button onClick={() => void revalidate()}>Refresh</button>

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Calling without arguments uses reason manual. shouldRevalidate can return false even for manual refresh. It refreshes the active page loader, not every fetcher. This API returns a function, unlike React Router’s object-shaped revalidator.
